nodes.answer: Females were kept in translucent plastic pots (1 L).

nodes.question: How were fecal pellets collected from small mammals in the field according to the methodology?
nodes.answer: Fecal pellets were collected using baited tubes made from plastic pipes, designed to allow small mammals to enter, feed, and defecate inside them.
